# VocazAI — Trilingual AI Voice Receptionist

VocazAI deploys trilingual AI voice receptionists (French · Arabic · English) for businesses of every size. The AI answers calls 24/7, books appointments, qualifies leads, and handles FAQs. The agent switches between the three languages mid-call based on what the caller speaks, with no manual setting required.

VocazAI is operated by **Mare Nostrum SARL**. Founded in 2025.

- Website: https://vocazai.com
- Contact (sales/demo): hello@vocazai.com · +33 7 77 34 50 56 (also on WhatsApp)
- Legal contact: legal@vocazai.com · Privacy: privacy@vocazai.com · Support: support@vocazai.com

---

## What VocazAI does

A business signs up, configures an AI voice agent through a dashboard (name, brand tone, FAQs, booking rules, voice gender/language), and attaches a phone number. The agent starts answering incoming calls within 24–48 hours, around the clock, in French, Arabic, or English depending on the caller. Every call is transcribed, summarized, and surfaced as a CRM task in the dashboard.

The agent can:
- Answer common questions (hours, services, prices, directions).
- Book, reschedule, or cancel appointments — synced with Google Calendar, Doctolib, or custom calendars.
- Qualify leads (budget, area, urgency) for sales teams.
- Confirm cash-on-delivery e-commerce orders.
- Triage urgency (e.g. medical red/yellow/green) and transfer live to a human when needed.
- Take a message and schedule a callback when transfer isn't possible.

---

## Languages

VocazAI is **trilingual by design** — the three languages are not a bolt-on:
- **French** — natural, professional, contextual.
- **Arabic** — native Arabic-script transcription and synthesis.
- **English** — clear, neutral.

The agent detects the caller's language from the first words and answers in the same language. If the caller switches mid-call, the agent switches too. Dashboard analytics show calls per language.

---

## Industries / use cases

### Clinics & medical practices
"Never again a patient on voicemail." The agent picks up in under a second, triages urgency (red/yellow/green), proposes an open slot, and sends SMS confirmation. Urgent cases are transferred immediately to the on-call line. Integrates with Doctolib, Google Calendar, and proprietary scheduling systems. Automated 24h reminders.

### Real estate agencies
"More leads. Better qualified." The agent takes every inbound call, qualifies the buyer/renter profile (budget, area, surface, urgency), books a viewing, and syncs the lead to your CRM. Salespeople only call hot leads. HubSpot / Pipedrive / Salesforce sync. Auto-distribution by agent availability.

### E-commerce & delivery
"Cash-on-delivery confirmations on autopilot." For markets where COD is still common, the agent calls every customer within 5 minutes of order, confirms address and availability, and drastically cuts return rates. Confirmation possible in French, Arabic, or English. Webhook to Shopify / WooCommerce / custom back-office. Auto-reschedules if the customer is unavailable.

### Restaurants & hospitality
"Reservations never sleep." The agent takes reservations 24/7 in three languages, knows your menu, handles special requests (allergies, birthdays), proposes available slots, and adds the booking to your floor management software. TheFork / Zenchef / SevenRooms integration. Multilingual SMS confirmation.

---

## How it works — three steps

1. **You describe your business.** Hours, services, brand tone, FAQs — we capture everything for the agent.
2. **We configure your agent.** Choice of voice (male/female, French/Arabic/English), calendar integration, qualification scripts.
3. **It picks up — tomorrow.** Connected to your landline or mobile number. Transcripts, summaries, and CRM tasks in your dashboard.

Setup time: 24–48 hours between brief and first answered call. No technical work on your side.

---

## Privacy & data

- All call recordings and transcripts are **encrypted at rest**.
- Per-tenant isolation via **PostgreSQL Row Level Security** (RLS) — clients never see each other's data.
- Data is **never sold to third parties**.
- You own your data: export or delete it anytime from the dashboard.
- A business may delete their account by contacting `support@vocazai.com`.
- The infrastructure runs on a dedicated VPS behind Traefik with HTTPS auto-renewal.

---

## Frequently asked questions

**Can my agent speak Arabic?**
Yes — VocazAI handles Arabic, French, and English. The agent switches between these three languages mid-call based on the caller.

**How long to set up?**
Plan on 24 to 48 hours between your brief and the first call answered by your agent. No technical setup on your side.

**What if the agent doesn't know the answer?**
You define the transfer rules. The agent can take a message, schedule a callback, or transfer live to your team.

**Is my data confidential?**
Yes. Recordings and transcripts are encrypted at rest, isolated per client (PostgreSQL RLS), and exportable or deletable on demand.

**What happens if I exceed my monthly minutes?**
You're billed prorated at $0.08 per extra minute, without any call interruption.

**Can I switch plans?**
Yes, anytime. The change is prorated from the day of switch.

**Are there setup fees?**
Zero. Our team configures your first agent for free during the trial.
